title: Braiding equivariance of the unit-tensor composite
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with braidings $\beta^{\mathcal C},\beta^{\mathcal D}$, meaning natural isomorphisms $X\otimes Y\to Y\otimes X$ satisfying the two hexagon identities. Let $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be a functor equipped with a lax monoidal structure: a unit map $\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\to R\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$ and natural maps $m_{P,Q}:RP\otimes RQ\to R(P\otimes Q)$ satisfying the associativity and unit coherence diagrams. Assume its braided identity
$$R(\beta^{\mathcal D}_{P,Q})\circ m_{P,Q}=m_{Q,P}\circ\beta^{\mathcal C}_{RP,RQ}$$
for all $P,Q\in\mathcal D$. For arbitrary objects $X,Y\in\mathcal C$, $P,Q\in\mathcal D$ and arrows $u:X\to RP$, $v:Y\to RQ$, put
$$a=m_{P,Q}\circ(u\otimes v):X\otimes Y\to R(P\otimes Q),\qquad b=m_{Q,P}\circ(v\otimes u):Y\otimes X\to R(Q\otimes P).$$
Then the following equality of maps $X\otimes Y\to R(Q\otimes P)$ holds:
$$R(\beta^{\mathcal D}_{P,Q})\circ a=b\circ\beta^{\mathcal C}_{X,Y}.$$
In particular this applies to $P=LX$, $Q=LY$, $u=\eta_X$, $v=\eta_Y$ for any adjunction $L:\mathcal C\rightleftarrows\mathcal D:R$ with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}\to RL$ (natural Hom bijections $\Phi_{X,V}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(LX,V)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,RV)$ and $\eta_X=\Phi_{X,LX}(\mathrm{id}_{LX})$).
